name: save-boot-7g-world-kalm-walk-out
description: Diagnostic for #140, attempt 2 (notes/140-world-live.md). Load as save-boot-7-world-kalm does (Circle every 30 frames until g_GameState 3), then 600 frames. Then attempt 1's presses (three Circle, three Cross), which leave the world map for a field; the field loads (segment field-loaded); 600 frames of Down to walk out of it; wait (up to 1800 frames) for the world map again (w_world), as a field exit leads there in normal play; 600 frames; a mark; 120 frames of Up. Reported: load_done, g_FieldCurrentMap at the end (the entry point), the player actor pointer (pc_lo) and the signs of pool element 7's pos.vx/vz change since the mark.
